articles.title: 26 Years Later, Peppermint Patty's Final 'Peanuts' Strip Is Still Her Most Memorable Quote
articles.summary: Here's an interesting fact about Peanuts: Peppermint Patty has a full canonical name, which was only ever mentioned once. It’s Patricia Reichardt, as per the strip for Jan. 15, 1972.
body: That's one of several ways in which Patty always felt like she was inhabiting a distinctly different strip than everyone else in Peanuts, and it’s not just because she and Marcie go to a different school than everyone else. In a comic where most of the characters regularly grapple with weighty issues related to theology, philosophy, and ethics, Patty gets poor grades, routinely sleeps through class, gets a D-minus on every test, and was convinced for a long time that Snoopy is just a funny-looking quiet kid instead of an actual dog.
On the other hand, Patty is a gifted athlete, and her baseball team routinely defeats Charlie Brown's. Everyone has their own talents.
Patty's academic underachievement does tend to mean that she's on the low end of the Peanuts quotability scale. When Patty's around in Peanuts, the jokes all tend to be at her own expense.

With that in mind, the most memorable line from Peppermint Patty might also be her last. Both Patty and her eternal sidekick Marcie made their final appearance in Peanuts on Jan. 2, 2000, around six weeks before the strip's conclusion.

articles.title: As the legal hunt for the GTA 6 leaker continues, Take-Two reportedly tries another more secretive Discord subpoena, this time specifying individuals
articles.summary: Rockstar parent company Take-Two has escalated its hunt for the people behind the numerous Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks from two weeks ago. The publisher has filed a request for another subpoena, though this time it's asking the court to withhold the details from the public and keep it sealed.
body: The subpoena request, as reported by TorrentFreak, is the second one aimed at Discord. Take-Two previously filed subpoena requests targeting multiple companies whose products were used to store and disseminate the leaked GTA 6 footage, including Discord, Microsoft, and X. Following these filings, Discord said it had yet to be served, and that it would "evaluate the validity and scope before responding" if and when it was.

Take-Two's tactics seem to be changing a bit, as the company is now trying to keep the public from being able to see details of the subpoena. Unlike the original public subpoenas, no one outside the court will be able to learn details of the information Take-Two is seeking this time. The company was criticised for the scope and scale of the information it requested in Discord's initial subpoena, which targeted hundreds of thousands of users across several Discord servers where the GTA 6 leaks mainly circulated.
points: Rockstar parent company Take-Two has escalated its hunt for the people behind the numerous Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks from two weeks ago.
The publisher has filed a request for another subpoena, though this time it's asking the court to withhold the details from the public and keep it sealed.

articles.title: 5 Perfect Animated Movies on Netflix That Are Better Than KPop Demon Hunters
articles.summary: KPop Demon Hunters debuted on Netflix in June 2025, and in short order, everyone lost their minds. The movie received hundreds of millions of views and even made its way into theaters, a very rare feat for a Netflix Original that started out on the streaming platform.
body: I get it. The songs are incredibly catchy and the movie is funnier and more action-packed than anybody could have expected. But while everyone is still so excited about KPop Demon Hunters, I’d like to point out that there are other — and, dare I say, better — animated movies on Netflix as well. There are films that have stood the test of time, others that managed to bring something new to longstanding fandoms, and plenty of straight-to-Netflix flicks that didn’t make quite the same splash, but are still arguably superior.
So if you’re at all fatigued by KPop Demon Hunter -mania, I invite you to scroll right past it on Netflix and check out these five animated masterpieces instead.

KPop Demon Hunters and The Mitchells vs. the Machines actually have quite a bit in common. Both are animated films that were produced by Sony Pictures Animation and were released directly onto Netflix. The Mitchells vs. the Machines reached over 50 million views on the platform within its first month, which doesn’t really compare to the mega-hit of KPop Demon Hunters. And yet, it was easily one of the biggest releases during the pandemic.

articles.title: 33 Years Ago, Batman’s Most Unforgettable Failure Predicted a Near-Perfect Action Series
articles.summary: Batman has one of the most formidable rogues’ galleries in comics, but Bane understood that none of those villains had to defeat the Dark Knight to be useful. They only had to keep him busy.
body: That is the cruel genius of Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall, the new animated adaptation of the iconic ‘90s storyline in which Bane breaks Batman’s back. Bane shows up in Gotham and orchestrates a mass breakout from Arkham Asylum, which forces Batman to spend days hunting down the Joker, Scarecrow, Poison Ivy, and various other escaped inmates. By the time Bruce returns to Wayne Manor, he is physically exhausted, psychologically frayed, and completely unprepared for Bane’s ambush. Only then does Bane fight him and famously “break the Bat.”

“Hidden Inventory / Premature Death” is presented as the first five episodes of JJK season 2, though it’s a prequel arc that takes place more than a decade before the main series. In their teenage years, Satoru Gojo and Suguru Geto are assigned to protect Riko Amanai, a schoolgirl designated as the Star Plasma Vessel (a human destined to merge with Tengen to reset their immortality). Since Gojo and Geto are both already classified as Special Grade jujutsu sorcerers, attacking them directly would be foolish.

articles.title: Duane Davis Found Guilty in Murder of Tupac Shakur
articles.summary: Duane “Keffe D” Davis has been found guilty of the 1996 murder of rapper and actor Tupac Shakur, reports ABC News. The verdict came after less than three hours of deliberation from the jury.
body: It was not argued by prosecutors that the now 63-year-old Davis fired the weapon that killed Shakur in the September 7, 1996 drive-by shooting near the Las Vegas Strip, but rather that he orchestrated the event and gave the gun to the shooter in their vehicle. It’s alleged Davis’ nephew Orlando Anderson, or another man in the backseat of the car, carried out the shooting. Anderson was killed in a reportedly unrelated 1998 gang shootout at a Compton, California car wash.

“For nearly 18 years, Duane Davis has told the police, television, books, YouTube interviewers – anybody that will listen, he has told – he is responsible for the murder of Tupac Shakur,” prosecutor Binu Palal told the jury. “Tell him you hear him – find him guilty.”

body: The S90F is the 2025 model in Samsung's S90 OLED TV lineup. This is the last TV in the S90 series that's equipped with a quantum dot OLED panel. This year, Samsung decided to remove quantum dot technology from the S90 series, which means the only way to get a QD-OLED TV in 2026 is splurging for the S95H TV. The 65" S95H TV sells for $2,800.

The S90F is equipped with Samsung's coveted quantum dot OLED panel which delivers a brighter picture and richer colors than W-OLED panels (like the one found in the S90H) while retaining all of the other benefits of OLED: near instaneous response time, true black levels, near infinite contrast ratio, and outstanding viewing angles. The Samsung S90F also has the features you'd want in a gaming TV, including a native 120Hz panel and HDMI 2.1 ports so you can run PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X games in 4K resolution at up to 120fps.

articles.title: 35 Years Later, This Remains the Most Near-Perfect Action Sci-Fi Movie of All Time
articles.summary: Speculative fiction is one of the most popular realms to both write and read, and science-fiction films have made tens of billions of dollars at the box office. In fact, eight of the top 10 highest-grossing films of all time have a sci-fi leans to them, whether it a film from the Marvel Cinematic…
body: That disctinction belongs to a picture Cameron released some decades earlier, one that helped redefine what blockbuster filmmaking could look like in the process, both in-front of and behind the camera. It was bigger than its predecessor in virtually every conceivable way, yet somehow avoided falling into the trap so many sequels do. In fact, most would consider it one of the only sequels in movie history to be better than its predecessor.

Released in 1991, Terminator 2: Judgment Day brings Arnold Schwarzenegger back as the titular machine, only this time he's been repogrammed and sent into the past to protect a young John Connor (Edward Furlong). Hunting them this time is Robert Patrick's T-1000, an advanced liquid-metal Terminator capable of changing its appearance and turning its body into a weapon.
The villain is enough reason to make Terminator 2 nearly flawless, but the accompanying action is very hard to top.

articles.title: Godzilla Remaster Devs Explain Why They Aren’t Worried About Releasing Near GTA 6
articles.summary: Most upcoming games have looked to steer clear of the behemoth that is Grand Theft Auto 6 and avoid the month of November entirely. The upcoming remaster of 2002's Godzilla Destroy All Monsters Melee is a notable exception, and as it turns out, the developers didn't think about GTA 6 at all when…
body: In an interview with IGN, senior designer at developer Pipeworks Simon Strange revealed GTA's looming release of November 16 wasn't a factor when choosing Godzilla Destroy All Monsters Melee: Remastered's November 3 release date.

Like others online, the development team got a kick out of kaiju fans celebrating the fact that the King of the Monsters (and Barbie) were the only two pop culture icons brave enough to face off against developer Rockstar's open-world juggernaut.

"Honestly, [it] wasn't even in our heads at all when we were picking the release date," Strange said. "That's not my business. I make the video games. I'm not too worried about when they come out. If Atari had come to us and said, 'Wow, we can't because we think it's going to affect the sales with GTA', we would've had that discussion. But no one ever said anything."

articles.title: “Trust Us–We’re Remedy:” Control Resonant Will Have Plenty Of Lore, The Devs Just Can’t Reveal Any Of It
articles.summary: Fear not, Control fans: Control Resonant will be packed with lore despite the combat-heavy trailers we've seen so far, according to developer Remedy. The lack of focus on story in promotional footage, says Remedy senior communications manager Miika Huttunen, is no reflection of the game's content…
body: The sneak peeks we've had of the game so far have been mainly combat-focused, a result of combat being something that doesn't need to be revealed gradually to the player. "There's lots of weird stuff to come," says Huttunen, "plenty of twists and turns and surprises… things to discover. We're asking fans to trust us--we're Remedy. And I hope that, because we're Remedy, we get the benefit of the doubt."

Lore-related collectibles, like FBC documents and written materials from pre-Hiss-invasion times, are scattered liberally throughout the game. It pays to explore and take your time finding secrets, as the world of Control Resonant is no less carefully crafted than its predecessor, and the story is far from an afterthought. Besides the written word, you'll also find countless places where you can open shortcuts, unpack subtle environmental clues, and have interactions with NPCs who help to expand your understanding of the world.

articles.title: The studio behind Star Wars Zero Company, which is currently a Steam bestseller, has reportedly furloughed the majority of its staff
articles.summary: That means affected staff are technically still employed by the company, but will receive no wage during the furlough period. A representative from Bit Reactor confirmed the furloughs to Game File, though didn't indicate how many employees are affected.
body: Other sources claim up to 80% of the studio has been impacted. According to the Bit Reactor rep, it is hoped that furloughed workers will be brought back with full pay.

A former Bit Reactor staffer, Zachariah Scott, who was let go by the studio earlier this year, addressed the furloughs on LinkedIn yesterday. "It is sick and weird to have all of these EA and Disney folks as well as Bitreactor Senior staff making all of these 10/10 posts about Star Wars Zero Company being such a huge success and praising the work of the team while seemingly concealing the fact that the team was furloughed weeks ago," Scott wrote.

He went on: "It is a gross but all too common sight to see, another corporate game hitting the top of Steam while the team is left looking for work and cut off from any possible profit sharing. It would be such a different story if they had been upfront about it earlier, and now it feels like they're trying to keep the team in a holding pattern with good vibes and more empty promises."

articles.title: A September 10 Nintendo Direct Is Looking Likely Thanks To Just Dance
articles.summary: Fans eager to see what Nintendo is cooking up for the 2026 holiday season might not have to wait long, as new evidence is making a September 10 Nintendo Direct look likely. That evidence in question is Just Dance: Decades of Hits.
body: "We're committed to sharing the complete picture with you on September 10, and we sincerely thank you for your patience and continued support in the meantime," Ubisoft's statement reads.

As highlighted by Nintendo Everything, Just Dance titles frequently appear during Nintendo Directs, with last year's Just Dance 2026 Edition announced during a summer presentation. Nintendo also has a history of premiering a Nintendo Direct ahead of the Tokyo Game Show, which kicks off on September 17 this year.

The September 10 date then is looking promising, especially when combined with Nintendo's previous history. We recently explained why a September Nintendo Direct is likely to happen; there has been an early-to-mid September Nintendo Direct almost every year for the past decade (with a late August direct in 2024 being the one exception).
We'll know if the September 10 date is real by September 9 at the latest, as Nintendo has a history of announcing a Direct with around 24 hours notice.

articles.title: Xbox CEO Says Making Halo Popular Again Is A Priority, But Franchise Co-Creator Questions If It’s Possible
articles.summary: The Halo franchise remains synonymous with the Xbox brand, but many might agree that it has seen better days. Xbox's new CEO, Asha Sharma, has now commented on Halo's future, saying in an interview that Halo remains a "very key franchise" for Xbox and that Microsoft is taking a long-term view about…
body: "The thing that I am learning about great games is that they have a long history and heritage and we can take a long-term view. I am confident that Halo is a very important part of our portfolio. It is a very key franchise. It represents a very key memory structure and way that people want to play," she told the BBC. "I am focused on that. We'll have more news to share on Halo going forward."

The latest entry in the Halo series was this past July's Halo: Campaign Evolved, a remaster of the 2001 original game released this year to celebrate the game's 25th anniversary. The game, which represented Halo's debut on PlayStation, was generally well-received, but apparently had a slow start for sales.
Industry analyst Rhys Elliott lamented the slowing sales and diminishing profile of Halo as a franchise in general after the series peaked, in his eyes, with Halo 3 and Halo: Reach years ago.

“One can’t help wondering what could have been if Halo had kept the trajectory it had around Halo 3 and Reach. A remake of the game that started it all landing this softly on a new platform makes me pretty sad, as a Halo fan,” he wrote.

articles.title: One of Elden Ring's top sleuths has already unmasked its new DLC characters
articles.summary: Longtime FromSoftware dataminer Zullie the Witch has come out with a new video showing off the close-up details of Elden Ring's two new NPC invaders. Knight Leontiel and Noble Broken Mask were both added to the game as part of Elden Ring's Tarnished Edition DLC.
body: Knight Leontiel is a straight "hey, I know them" reference to Lucatiel of Mirrah from Dark Souls 2, boasting an HD remaster of her signature conquistador fit and nimble greatsword. Take off the mask, though, and Leontiel practically is Lucatiel, even down to a burn mark over her left eye that corresponds to the hollowing rot Lucatiel suffered in Dark Souls 2.

Noble Broken Mask, meanwhile, may obliquely give us a better idea of what his base game counterpart and spiritual rival, Goldmask, is supposed to look like. Goldmask's model has a face, but it seems like a generic placeholder element. Broken Mask has an austere, pinched face with striking pale gold eyes, and Zullie points out that he bears a more than passing resemblance to the typically obscured faces of Elden Ring's perfumer enemies.

videos.title: Stranded Deep 2 - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer
videos.summary: Take a look at the Stranded Deep 2 announcement teaser trailer for this upcoming survival sandbox sequel game. Standed Deep 2 will be available on PC.
body: In Stranded Deep 2, the survival sandbox expands into an unforgiving desert wilderness. Rather than being stranded in the vast expanse of the Pacific Ocean, players must now survive within a harsh landscape shaped by scorching heat, winding rivers, towering canyons and deadly wildlife, with a whole new world of biomes to explore and resources to discover. But the desert is only the beginning.

Stranded Deep 2 is a frontier exploration survival game. Players start as survivors, grow into explorers, and gradually discover that there is far more to the world than simply staying alive. At the heart of the experience is an endless river world, carving through canyons, dunes and valleys and providing a lifeline into a vast wilderness filled with danger and discovery.

videos.summary: Take a look at the 'Meet Natla' Overview for Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, the upcoming action-adventure remake of the original Tomb Raider developed by Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog.
points: Take a look at the 'Meet Natla' Overview for Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, the upcoming action-adventure remake of the original Tomb Raider developed by Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog.
Players will hear from Adrienne Wilkinson on her portrayal of Jacqueline Natla, a key role in pushing Lara Croft to go the distance.
Explore more of Jacqueline Natla in Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, launching on February 12 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
